earnings.title: GE HealthCare reports third quarter 2026 financial results
highlights: Revenue growth of 7.2%, and Organic revenue growth* of 6.2%
Net income margin of 11.1% and Adjusted earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) margin* of 16.6%; diluted EPS of $1.36 grew 39.1% and Adjusted EPS* of $1.34 grew 25.1%
Revenues of $5.5 billion, up 7.2%, including Organic revenue growth* of 6.2%, with growth across all segments.
Organic orders growth of 4.0% , book-to-bill of 1.03 times and backlog of $23.7 billion
Cash flow from operating activities of $907 million and Free cash flow* of $793 million

items.heading: We operate in highly competitive markets, competition may increase in the future, and our industry may be disrupted, requiring us to lower prices or resulting in a loss of market share.
Global geopolitical and economic instability, as well as continuing uncertainties and challenging conditions in regional economies, could adversely affect our business.

Public health crises and epidemics and pandemics have had and, in the future, may have a material adverse impact on our business, as well as on the operations and financial performance of customers and suppliers in industries that we serve.

Efforts by public and private payers to control the growth of healthcare costs may lead to lower reimbursements or increased utilization controls related to the use of our products by healthcare providers, which may affect the price of and demand for our products, services, or solutions.
Our inability to successfully complete strategic transactions could adversely affect our business.

If we do not successfully manage our collaboration arrangements, licensing arrangements, joint ventures, or strategic alliances with third parties, we may not realize the expected benefits from such arrangements, which could adversely affect our business.
